Bay View Bicycle Club Sunday Ride, 3 Trails West

Waukesha, WI · Road

Bay View Bicycle Club Sunday Ride, 3 Trails West is a road group ride in Waukesha, WI. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Fox River Sanctuary.

For visitors

A daily or annual Wisconsin state trail pass is required on all routes. The listing says you can ride as a guest with the club.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bay View Bicycle Club Sunday Ride, 3 Trails West group ride

Bay View Bicycle Club's Sunday trail ride starts at Fox River Sanctuary in Waukesha at 9:00 am. Riders go out and back on the Glacial Drumlin, Cushing Park and Lake Country trails to Wales, Lapham Peak, Delafield or Oconomowoc. A Wisconsin state trail pass is required.
